use default

permutation_between(before: string, after: string) -> LIST[int] is
    let one_line = LIST()

    for letter in after do
        one_line.add(before.index_of(letter) + 1)
    od

    return one_line
si

apply(one_line: Collections.List[int], text: string) -> string =>
    string(one_line |> map(source => text[source - 1]) |> collect_array())

inverse(one_line: Collections.List[int]) -> LIST[int] is
    let result = LIST(one_line)

    for (target, source) in one_line |> index() do
        result[source - 1] = target + 1
    od

    return result
si

compose(first: Collections.List[int], second: Collections.List[int])
        -> LIST[int] =>
    second |> map(source => first[source - 1]) |> collect_list()

cycles(one_line: Collections.List[int]) -> LIST[LIST[int]] is
    let destination = inverse(one_line)
    let found = LIST()
    let seen = LIST()

    for _ in one_line do
        seen.add(false)
    od

    for start in 0..one_line.count do
        if !seen[start] then
            let cycle = LIST()
            let position mut = start

            while !seen[position] do
                seen[position] = true
                cycle.add(position + 1)
                position = destination[position] - 1
            od

            if cycle.count > 1 then
                found.add(cycle)
            fi
        fi
    od

    return found
si

one_line(cycle_notation: Collections.List[LIST[int]], size: int)
        -> LIST[int] is
    let result = LIST()

    for position in 1::size do
        result.add(position)
    od

    for cycle in cycle_notation do
        for (index, position) in cycle |> index() do
            result[cycle[(index + 1) % cycle.count] - 1] = position
        od
    od

    return result
si

gcd(a: int, b: int) -> int => if b == 0 then a else gcd(b, a % b) fi

order(one_line: Collections.List[int]) -> int =>
    cycles(one_line)
        |> map(cycle => cycle.count)
        |> reduce(1, (acc, length) => acc * length / gcd(acc, length))

signature(one_line: Collections.List[int]) -> int is
    let even_cycles = cycles(one_line)
        |> filter(c => c.count % 2 == 0)
        |> count()

    return if even_cycles % 2 == 0 then 1 else -1 fi
si

show_one_line(one_line: Collections.List[int]) -> string is
    let trimmed = LIST(one_line)

    while trimmed.count > 0 /\
          trimmed[trimmed.count - 1] == trimmed.count do
        trimmed.remove_at(trimmed.count - 1)
    od

    return trimmed |> map(p => "{p}") |> join(" ")
si

show_cycles(one_line: Collections.List[int]) -> string =>
    cycles(one_line)
        |> map(cycle => "({cycle |> map(p => "{p}") |> join(" ")})")
        |> join(" ")

let days = [
    (name = "Mon", letters = "HANDYCOILSERUPT"), (name = "Tue", letters = "SPOILUNDERYACHT"),
    (name = "Wed", letters = "DRAINSTYLEPOUCH"), (name = "Thu", letters = "DITCHSYRUPALONE"),
    (name = "Fri", letters = "SOAPYTHIRDUNCLE"), (name = "Sat", letters = "SHINEPARTYCLOUD"),
    (name = "Sun", letters = "RADIOLUNCHTYPES")
]

write_line("permutations from each day to the next:")

for (index, (name, letters)) in days |> index() do
    let (next_name, next_letters) = days[(index + 1) % days.count]
    let permutation = permutation_between(letters, next_letters)

    write_line("  {name}->{next_name}: {show_one_line(permutation)}")
    write_line("    cycles: {show_cycles(permutation)}")
    let order_and_sign = "{order(permutation)}, {signature(permutation)}"

    write_line("    order and signature: {order_and_sign}")
od

let wed_to_thu = permutation_between(days[2].letters, days[3].letters)
let thu_to_fri = permutation_between(days[3].letters, days[4].letters)

write_line("")
write_line("Wed->Thu applied to Wed: {apply(wed_to_thu, days[2].letters)}")
write_line("Thu->Wed (inverse):      {show_cycles(inverse(wed_to_thu))}")
let thu_to_wed = inverse(wed_to_thu)

write_line("Thu->Wed applied to Thu: {apply(thu_to_wed, days[3].letters)}")

let wed_to_fri = compose(wed_to_thu, thu_to_fri)

write_line("Thu->Fri.Wed->Thu = Wed->Fri:")
write_line("  {show_cycles(wed_to_fri)}")
write_line("Wed->Fri applied to Wed: {apply(wed_to_fri, days[2].letters)}")

let rebuilt = one_line(cycles(wed_to_fri), 15)

write_line("Wed->Fri one-line:        {show_one_line(wed_to_fri)}")
write_line("Wed->Fri from its cycles: {show_one_line(rebuilt)}")
